target_customer: Engineering teams at software companies that run production services and on-call rotations
problem: Alert noise and manual triage burden on-call engineers. Struct sets up monitors, tunes thresholds, triages alerts and can open fix pull requests.
business_model: B2B SaaS with a Pro plan from 200 dollars a month plus enterprise plans
product_category: AI on-call and production reliability agent

founders.name: Nimesh Chakravarthi
founders.background_notes: YC page: led the consumer messaging team at LinkedIn.

founders.name: Deepan Mehta
founders.background_notes: Senior PM at LinkedIn for four years; earlier launched LiveRamp self-serve distribution APIs.

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrating with many observability tools and getting reliable root cause analysis from LLMs is hard in practice, though built from existing models and APIs.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and learned alert baselines add some lock in, but Datadog, PagerDuty and several funded AI SRE startups cover the same wedge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: AWS DevOps Agent became generally available in March 2026 and incident.io raised 62M for AI incident agents; no acquisition of Struct found.

market_need_then: On-call fatigue and alert noise are long standing complaints, and AI SRE became a funded category in 2025 (Resolve.ai at a reported 1B valuation), but source dates near the batch are missing.

branding.domain_note: Uses struct.ai; legal entity VillageAI, Inc. operating as Struct; earlier product named Bramble per a directory.

identity.visual_style: Clean minimal layout with theme toggle
identity.voice_and_tone: Short, confident, playful: 'You ship. Struct watches.' and 'Go off-call'.

branding.community_and_virality: Won Product Hunt Launch of the Day on 2026-03-14 per a third party listing.

brand_strength.rationale: Short name but generic and shared with Structured AI and others; limited brand press.

pivots.from: Bramble, a real estate AI concept per a third party directory
pivots.why: Not stated; directory claim is unverified

outcome_analysis: Struct is active with three people, SOC 2 Type II, named customers such as Opendoor and Orb, and a Product Hunt launch in March 2026, but no funding round or traction numbers were found. AI SRE is crowded and well funded, so the outcome is undetermined.
notes: Third party directory lists an estimated 500K based on the YC standard deal, not a disclosed round, so not recorded. The Bramble pivot comes from one directory and may be inaccurate; YC jobs and a search hit reference a Bramble YC page. VCBacked returned an unrelated voice agent Struct. Competitor search results were 2025 and 2026 roundups with no dates near F24, so list empty. Name origin not found.
